scope: Development video, manually selected game viewport; independent single-frame labels, production reading controller and scorer, seeded default crafting field template, no colour inference, no temporal retries. First case per mode includes worker startup. Native game pixels; category preview limited to 1280 px as in capture. Isolated factory profile with empty owned inventory; personalized score/KEEP correctness not evaluated. Baseline failures are measurements, not harness test failures.
